articles.title: Pratapgarh Shock: Constable Slaps Woman, Smashes Her Phone Over Parking Dispute!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident from Pratapgarh has sparked outrage after a police constable was caught on camera repeatedly slapping a woman during a parking dispute. According to reports, the incident occurred outside Mangarh Dham in Kunda around 7 PM on Thursday.

body.html:
A shocking incident from Pratapgarh has sparked outrage after a police constable was caught on camera repeatedly slapping a woman during a parking dispute.

According to reports, the incident occurred outside Mangarh Dham in Kunda around 7 PM on Thursday. Swati Singh, a resident of Prayagraj, had parked her car in a no-parking zone. Constable Shivam Samdarshi from the Kunda police’s mobile patrol team arrived on a bike and began scolding the family while recording them on his mobile phone.

Even as the family started moving the car, Swati objected to being filmed and began recording him in return. This led to an altercation during which the constable allegedly snatched her mobile phone and threw it on the ground. When Swati pushed him back, he slapped her thrice in the middle of the road, shocking bystanders who quickly intervened.

Following the incident, Swati’s family protested at the Kunda police station, demanding immediate suspension of the constable and a public apology.

Two videos related to the case have surfaced — one showing the assault, and another CCTV clip showing Swati calmly moving her vehicle while the constable continues recording her.

Circle Officer Amarnath Gupta confirmed that CCTV footage has been recovered and an inquiry is underway. Witnesses are also being questioned.

articles.title: SP Leader Deepak Giri & Fiancée Poonam Pandit Booked — Girlfriend Alleges Drugging, Blackmail
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut, Uttar Pradesh: A sensational case has emerged involving Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Deepak Giri and his fiancée Poonam Pandit, after a woman, claiming to be Deepak’s girlfriend, lodged a serious complaint accusing him of sexual assault, blackmail, extortion, and threats to life.

body.html:
Meerut, Uttar Pradesh: A sensational case has emerged involving Samajwadi Party (SP) leader Deepak Giri and his fiancée Poonam Pandit, after a woman, claiming to be Deepak’s girlfriend, lodged a serious complaint accusing him of sexual assault, blackmail, extortion, and threats to life.

According to the FIR filed at Bhawanpur police station on Saturday night, the complainant — an officer in the Milk Development Department, Meerut — alleged that Deepak laced her cold drink with drugs, made obscene videos of her, and later used them to blackmail her for ₹40–50 lakh.

The FIR names five accused — Deepak Giri (former district president, SP Yuva Sabha), his father Krishnapal, his brothers Kuldeep and Pradeep, and his fiancée Poonam Pandit.

The woman said Deepak first contacted her via Facebook in 2018, took her phone number, and invited her to meet. During one such meeting, she was allegedly drugged and sexually assaulted in a house in Gangasagar. Later, she claims, he repeatedly exploited and blackmailed her using the videos.

“He married me in June 2021 at Arya Samaj Temple for show, just to silence me,” the complainant stated in her FIR. “After his engagement to Poonam Pandit, he and his family started threatening to kill me.”

The victim further alleged that on October 16, she was held hostage and assaulted by Deepak and his brothers when she went to meet him in Mawana. Two days later, on October 19, she was allegedly forcibly taken into a car and threatened by Deepak and Poonam, who demanded that she withdraw her allegations posted on social media.

Following these revelations, Deepak Giri was removed from his SP post. Earlier, his engagement photos with Poonam Pandit — known for her role in the farmers’ protest and her 2022 Assembly run from Syana, Bulandshahr on a Congress ticket — had gone viral, prompting the victim to create a public uproar outside his home.

The woman also released a 26-minute video on Facebook, claiming that she and Deepak lived together in a house they purchased in 2021, where she endured “four years of torture and blackmail.”

Meanwhile, Poonam Pandit said:
“I will not allow injustice to happen to any woman. If Deepak turns out to be a fraud, I will break the engagement myself and support the victim in filing an FIR.”

Police have registered a case under serious IPC and cybercrime sections, including those related to sexual assault, blackmail, criminal intimidation, and cheating.

Investigations are underway.

A viral video has triggered a major controversy after it allegedly showed one of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s official vehicles being washed at a local car cleaning station.

The footage, reportedly filmed and posted on Instagram by the car wash owner, shows a fleet of black SUVs resembling those used in the PM’s motorcade. Social media users claimed that the vehicle seen is the same car in which the Prime Minister travels.

Questions are being raised over how such a high-security vehicle could end up at a public facility, bypassing SPG-supervised maintenance protocols. Many have called it a serious lapse and potential security threat, urging clarification from the PMO and SPG.

body.html:
Moradabad, UP — A shocking case has surfaced at Jamia Ahsanul Banat Girls Madrasa in Lodhipur, where the management allegedly demanded a virginity certificate from a Class 8 student for re-admission.

The girl’s father, a resident of Chandigarh, lodged a complaint with SSP Satpal Antil, alleging that admission cell in-charge Shahjahan and principal Rahnuma demanded the certificate and, when refused, pressured his daughter to take a transfer certificate.

Following the complaint, police conducted an inquiry and arrested Shahjahan on Friday. A team from the Minority Welfare Department is also expected to visit the madrasa for further investigation.

SP City Ranvijay Singh confirmed that strict action has been ordered against those responsible.

articles.title: Kurnool Horror: 25+ Dead as Bengaluru-Hyderabad Bus Bursts Into Flames — Expired Fitness
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh — In a horrifying incident, a private travels bus was completely gutted in flames, killing over 25 passengers and leaving several others injured on the Chinnatekuru main road in Kurnool district early Friday morning.

body.html:
Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh — In a horrifying incident, a private travels bus was completely gutted in flames, killing over 25 passengers and leaving several others injured on the Chinnatekuru main road in Kurnool district early Friday morning.

The ill-fated Kaveri Travels bus (DD 01 AN 9190) was travelling from Bengaluru to Hyderabad when it suddenly caught fire. According to eyewitnesses, the blaze spread rapidly, trapping passengers inside. Locals reported that around 42 passengers were onboard, and only 12 managed to survive. A two-wheeler passing by was also caught under the bus and burned in the fire.

Rescue teams rushed to the spot but faced difficulties as the flames engulfed the vehicle entirely within minutes. The visuals from the scene showed the bus reduced to a charred shell, with thick smoke billowing from the wreckage.

Shocking details have since emerged — official records reveal that the bus’s fitness certificate expired on March 31, while its insurance and pollution certificates expired in April last year.

The bus, operated by Vemuri Kaveri Private Travels, had departed from Patancheru at 9:30 PM the previous night, picking up passengers at multiple stops in Hyderabad before heading toward Bengaluru.

Authorities have launched an inquiry into possible negligence by the travel company and are verifying whether the vehicle was operating illegally without valid documents.

articles.title: Rajasthan SDM’s Slapgate: Officer, Pump Staff Exchange Blows in Bhilwara — 3 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident from Bhilwara, Rajasthan, has gone viral after SDM of Pratapgarh, Chhotu Lal Sharma, was caught on CCTV (21 Oct 2025) slapping a petrol pump employee during an argument over refuelling priority — only to be slapped back by the staff.

body.html:
A shocking incident from Bhilwara, Rajasthan, has gone viral after SDM of Pratapgarh, Chhotu Lal Sharma, was caught on CCTV (21 Oct 2025) slapping a petrol pump employee during an argument over refuelling priority — only to be slapped back by the staff.

The altercation took place at a CNG and petrol station in Jaswantpura area, when the SDM reportedly demanded to be served first, claiming he had arrived earlier. As the argument escalated, Sharma allegedly slapped one employee, prompting an instant retaliation.

Police have since arrested three employees — Deepak Mali, Prabhu Lal Kumawat, and Raja Sharma — but no action has been taken against the SDM yet.

After the video went viral, Sharma’s wife, Deepika Vyas, alleged that the staff had harassed her and made obscene remarks, which triggered the confrontation. However, no CCTV evidence has been found supporting her claim.

The incident has sparked a massive debate online, with users slamming the “VIP arrogance” and double standards in police action.
